executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by customer operations, open-source stack, workflow orchestration. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.

The open-source layer is turning into a strategic option set for AI stack design, not only a hobbyist ecosystem.
Execution architecture is becoming more important than one-shot generation quality in operational AI.
